description: This file defines an interface 'IProviderBuilder' for configuring Orleans service providers, parameterized by a builder type, with a method to configure the provider using a configuration section.

classes.name: IProviderBuilder<TBuilder>
classes.description: A generic interface for building and configuring Orleans providers with a specified builder type.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the provider with the given builder, optional name, and configuration section.
